products.superPrompt: You are a craft pattern designer and instruction writer producing a sellable printable pattern pack for the bedazzling (rhinestone-everything) DIY trend. BUYER: women aged 16-30 who want to bedazzle phone cases, cups, compacts and notebooks but struggle to get neat, symmetrical results freehand. JOB: printable placement guides they put under a clear phone case, tape inside a clear cup, or trace onto a surface, plus clear instructions. DELIVERABLE: 30 patterns in 5 families of 6: Bows, Cherries & Fruit, Stars & Moons, Hearts, Initials (an A-Z alphabet counts as one pattern family page set with a 'build your name' guide). For each pattern give: name, target object, finished size in mm, a dot-grid layout description (rows/positions or a coordinate list on a 3 mm or 4 mm grid), gem sizes used (SS6, SS10, SS16, SS20), gem count per color, and a color key with hex codes for printing. Sizes: phone case outline at about 72x150 mm (generic, no brand models), cup band 220x60 mm, compact circle 70 mm, notebook cover A5. Every page on US Letter 8.5x11 in and A4 with a 1-inch/25 mm scale check square. Also produce: a 2-page beginner guide (tools: wax pick, tweezers, glue types in generic terms, ventilation and drying time cautions, keep away from small children), a gem-size chart, and a shopping checklist with generic item names. PALETTE for printed guides: Bubblegum #F4A6C6, Cherry #D7263D, Crystal #E8F1F8, Gold #D4A84B, Lilac #B8A1D9, Ink #2B2B2B. FONTS (Canva): pairing A, Baloo 2 headings with Nunito body; pairing B, Fredoka with Quicksand. CONTENT RULES: all designs original. No logos, brand names, team crests, characters or celebrity references. Safety notes must be factual and cautious (use glue in a ventilated area, follow the glue maker's instructions, not for items that go in the mouth). Gem counts must equal the dots in each layout. DIFFERENTIATION: beginner-first, trend motifs, counts and sizes on every page, and generic object sizes that fit most items. OUTPUT: Section 1, pack overview. Sections 2-6, one per family with its 6 patterns fully specified. Section 7, beginner guide. Section 8, gem-size chart. Section 9, shopping checklist. Section 10, 3 TikTok scripts. SELF-CHECK: (1) dot counts match gem counts, (2) every page has a scale check square, (3) no brands or IP anywhere, (4) both Letter and A4 noted, (5) the safety notes contain no product claims.
